name: 31_uk_quoted_names
description: Quoted names without a legal form: a product name ('КАСКО «Оптимум»') and a quoted party followed by a defined term. Span = the text inside the guillemets (the quotes and the word КАСКО stay). Later occurrences are found by value. Both are normal precision (no legal form).
